errors.evidence: The x-axis range shown on the plot is from 95,000 to 125,000, not 90,000 to 130,000.
The plot's x-axis begins at 95,000, but the description states the line starts at 90,000 iterations. This error is repeated for all three SepLLM lines.
The plot's x-axis ends at 125,000, but the description states the line ends at 127,000 iterations. This error is repeated for all three SepLLM lines.
The description omits the shaded areas around the three SepLLM lines, which represent variance or a confidence interval.
